name: sgs/form-field-consent
title: SGS Consent Field
description: Consent checkbox for GDPR, terms, and marketing.

consent.label: Consent checkbox + text
consent._note: Unlike its single-input siblings, this block has no separate <label> call — it renders one wrapping <label class="sgs-form-field__consent"> containing the <input type="checkbox"> and a <span class="sgs-form-field__consent-text">. No per-instance colour/font-size/weight attribute exists for either; both are styled entirely by shared framework CSS. clusters: [] is a genuine gap, not hidden. The orphan scanner reports consentText/consentType as ORPHANs against this element's 'consent' prefix (element-key-as-fallback-prefix convention) — a known false-positive, not an unaccounted style control (both are content/behaviour attributes, not style).

help.label: Help text
help._note:
helpText itself is field-behaviour content, not a style property (Bean's non-cluster rule) — the rendered

also carries no per-instance style attribute of its own. clusters: []. The conformance checker's orphan scanner reports helpText as an ORPHAN here (element-key-as-fallback-prefix convention coincidentally matches help+Text); this is a known false-positive of the checker, not evidence of an unaccounted style control.

error.label: Error message
error._note: Populated by client-side validation JS, not a block attribute; the <span class="sgs-form-field__error"> has no per-instance style attribute. clusters: [].

consentText.default: I agree to the Terms & Conditions

attributes.label: I agree to the terms and conditions and privacy policy.
